name: xplainer
description: The xplainer skill and the local MCP server it drives, for building narrated explainer videos on your own machine.

plugins.name: xplainer
plugins.description: Turn a bug, a root cause, or an architecture decision into a short narrated explainer video with captions, rendered to one MP4. Rendering uses Remotion: depending on the size of your company and how you use it, you may need your own Remotion licence — see https://remotion.pro/license.
